prompts.woman: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset: a standalone vertical photographic portrait for an explicitly labelled illustrative website card, not a real testimonial person's identity. Create one fictional adult Indian woman, about 25 to 30, in a relaxed everyday office setting in Gujarat. Waist-up documentary portrait, standing naturally, body slightly angled but face and eyes toward camera, her face centered horizontally in the upper 42 percent of the image with generous headroom, hands below crop. Warm medium-brown skin with real pores, tiny natural blemishes, subtle under-eye texture, asymmetrical gentle closed-mouth smile, dark brown eyes, natural dark hair loosely tied back with a few flyaways. Plain muted terracotta cotton kurta, tiny simple stud earrings, minimal or no visible makeup. Soft indirect daylight from an ordinary office window, believable Indian office background with pale warm wall and a softly out-of-focus bookshelf, no signage. Everyday smartphone documentary photograph with a 50mm-equivalent perspective, realistic modest depth of field, slight natural grain, nuanced shadows and neutral white balance. Natural and unretouched, never a fashion shoot. Portrait orientation 3:4. No text, letters, logo, graphic frames, watermarks, neon, staged props, airbrushed skin, beauty filters, excessive bokeh, glossy CGI, surreal symmetry or exaggerated smile. One person only. Keep the upper half uncluttered and leave the lower quarter suitable for a website text overlay.
